        bytes[at] = colour.red
        bytes[at + 1] = colour.green
        bytes[at + 2] = colour.blue
    si

         (red = bytes[at], green = bytes[at + 1], blue = bytes[at + 2]))

space(value: ubyte) -> bool =>
    value == 32ub \/ value == 9ub \/ value == 10ub \/ value == 13ub

    let at mut = 0

    let token = () -> string is
        while at < raw.count /\ (space(raw[at]) \/ raw[at] == 35ub) do

                od

        while at < raw.count /\ !space(raw[at]) do
            at = at + 1
        od

            (from..at)

                |> collect_array()
        )
    si

    assert token() =~ "P6" else "not a binary PPM"

    let width = int.parse(token())
    let height = int.parse(token())

    let _ = token()

    at = at + 1

    let image = BITMAP(width, height)

    for index in 0..width * height * 3 do
        image.bytes[index] = raw[at + index]
    od

    return image

    let header =
        System.Text.Encoding.ascii.get_bytes(
            "P6\n{image.width} {image.height}\n255\n"
        )

    file.write(header, 0, header.count)

    let pixels = image.bytes |> collect_array()

    file.write(pixels, 0, pixels.count)

    file.dispose()

to_grey(image: BITMAP) -> BITMAP is
    let grey = BITMAP(image.width, image.height)

    for at in 0..image.width * image.height do
        let level =
            cast ubyte(
                0.2126D * cast double(image.bytes[at * 3]) +
                0.7152D * cast double(image.bytes[at * 3 + 1]) +
                0.0722D * cast double(image.bytes[at * 3 + 2]) + 0.5D
            )

        grey.bytes[at * 3] = level
        grey.bytes[at * 3 + 1] = level
        grey.bytes[at * 3 + 2] = level
    od

    return grey

            (red = cast ubyte(255 * x / source.width),
             green = cast ubyte(255 * y / source.height),

    od
od
